## Required

- [ ] **Licence.** My code contribution is licensed **GPL-3.0-or-later**.
      No CLA, no copyright assignment — you keep your copyright. Inbound simply
      has to match outbound, because this project is a T-Engine4 derivative.
- [ ] **Authorship.** I wrote this, or it is ported from T-Engine4 and every
      ported file carries the header from CONTRIBUTING.md, including a
      `file:lines` citation. An uncited port is indistinguishable from code of
      unknown provenance and will be sent back.
- [ ] **No assets.** This PR contains **no** images, audio, fonts, or other
      binary files. Not "no unlicensed assets" — none at all. The art tree is
      All Rights Reserved, and one third-party file in it permanently destroys
      the ability to say so.
- [ ] **No personal data.** No Discord user IDs, display names, real hostnames
      or IP addresses in the diff, the description, or any pasted log. Replace
      snowflakes with `<user1>`.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally, and I have not added a dependency.
